project.name: FpML OTC Derivatives
project.description: A bank's OTC derivatives trade store modelled on the ISDA FpML (Financial products Markup Language) structures: parties, trade header, products (interest rate swaps, FX, credit default swaps, swaptions) with their schedules, lifecycle events, valuations and FpML messages. 3NF for Databricks Unity Catalog. Property fpml_element on tables points to the FpML element each table represents; the mapping is indicative and should be checked against the FpML version in use.

policies.name: Data Protection
policies.description: Confidential client and trade data: least-privilege access, and reads are logged.

policies.name: Dodd-Frank
policies.description: Dodd-Frank Act Title VII (CFTC Parts 43 and 45): swap data goes to a swap data repository, with real-time public reporting; records are kept for the life of the swap plus five years.

policies.name: EMIR
policies.description: European Market Infrastructure Regulation: every derivative is reported to a trade repository by the next working day; records are kept at least five years after the contract ends.

policies.name: GDPR
policies.description: EU General Data Protection Regulation for data about people (traders, client contacts): a lawful basis, data-subject rights, breach notification within 72 hours.

policies.name: Market Abuse (MAR)
policies.description: Market Abuse Regulation: trading is monitored for insider dealing and market manipulation, and suspicious transactions are reported (STOR).

policies.name: Mask Personal Data
policies.description: Names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers are masked for everyone outside client onboarding.

policies.name: MiFID II
policies.description: MiFID II / MiFIR transaction reporting to the competent authority by the next working day, and post-trade transparency; records are kept five years.

policies.name: Record Retention
policies.description: Trade, event, valuation and message records are kept for the life of the trade plus at least five years, then deleted.

policies.name: Regulatory Reporting
policies.description: Derivatives are reported to trade repositories and regulators: complete, accurate and on time, with a UTI for every trade and an LEI for every counterparty.

tables.name: mv_daily_npv_by_book
tables.description: Sum of NPV per valuation date, book and currency. Refreshed after each valuation run; feeds the risk dashboard.
tables.definition:
SELECT vs.valuation_date, b.book_name, vm.currency_code, COUNT(DISTINCT vs.trade_id) AS trade_count, SUM(vm.amount) AS total_npv
FROM banking.valuation.valuation_set vs
JOIN banking.valuation.valuation_measure vm ON vm.valuation_set_id = vs.valuation_set_id AND vm.measure_type_code = 'NPV'
JOIN banking.trade.trade t ON t.trade_id = vs.trade_id
JOIN banking.party.book b ON b.book_id = t.book_id
GROUP BY vs.valuation_date, b.book_name, vm.currency_code

tables.name: mv_trade_events_daily
tables.description: Count of lifecycle events per business date and event type, for operations monitoring.
tables.definition:
SELECT e.event_date, et.trade_event_type_name AS event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM banking.trade.trade_event e
JOIN banking.ref.trade_event_type et ON et.trade_event_type_code = e.trade_event_type_code
GROUP BY e.event_date, et.trade_event_type_name

tables.name: v_active_trades_by_counterparty
tables.description: Number of active trades per counterparty and asset class: a quick exposure overview.
tables.definition:
SELECT p.party_id, p.party_name, pt.asset_class_code, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trade_id) AS active_trade_count
FROM banking.trade.trade t
JOIN banking.trade.trade_party_role r ON r.trade_id = t.trade_id AND r.party_role_code = 'Counterparty'
JOIN banking.party.party p ON p.party_id = r.party_id AND p.is_internal = false
JOIN banking.product.product pr ON pr.product_id = t.product_id
JOIN banking.ref.product_type pt ON pt.product_type_code = pr.product_type_code
WHERE t.trade_status_code = 'Active'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name, pt.asset_class_code

tables.name: v_irs_stream_schedule
tables.description: Interest rate swap streams with payer, receiver, dates, index/spread, latest fixed rate and initial notional.
tables.definition:
SELECT t.trade_id, s.swap_stream_id, s.stream_number, s.stream_kind,
       payer.party_name AS payer, receiver.party_name AS receiver, s.currency_code, s.day_count_fraction_code,
       cpd.effective_date, cpd.termination_date, cpd.period_multiplier, cpd.period_unit_code,
       f.floating_rate_index_code, f.spread,
       (SELECT MAX_BY(fr.fixed_rate, fr.step_start_date) FROM banking.product.fixed_rate_step fr WHERE fr.swap_stream_id = s.swap_stream_id) AS fixed_rate,
       (SELECT MIN_BY(n.notional_amount, n.step_start_date) FROM banking.product.notional_step n WHERE n.swap_stream_id = s.swap_stream_id) AS initial_notional
FROM banking.trade.trade t
JOIN banking.product.interest_rate_swap irs ON irs.product_id = t.product_id
JOIN banking.product.swap_stream s ON s.product_id = irs.product_id
JOIN banking.party.party payer ON payer.party_id = s.payer_party_id
JOIN banking.party.party receiver ON receiver.party_id = s.receiver_party_id
JOIN banking.product.calculation_period_dates cpd ON cpd.swap_stream_id = s.swap_stream_id
LEFT JOIN banking.product.floating_rate_spec f ON f.swap_stream_id = s.swap_stream_id

columns.name: fixed_rate
columns.description: Rate of the latest fixed-rate step

columns.name: initial_notional
columns.description: Notional of the earliest notional step

tables.name: v_party_directory
tables.description: Parties with type, country, LEI, BIC and ultimate parent for client and counterparty lookups.
tables.definition:
SELECT p.party_id, p.party_name, pt.party_type_name AS party_type, c.country_name, lei.identifier_value AS lei, bic.identifier_value AS bic,
       parent.party_name AS ultimate_parent_name, p.is_internal
FROM banking.party.party p
JOIN banking.ref.party_type pt ON pt.party_type_code = p.party_type_code
LEFT JOIN banking.ref.country c ON c.country_code = p.country_code
LEFT JOIN banking.party.party_identifier lei ON lei.party_id = p.party_id AND lei.id_scheme_code = 'LEI'
LEFT JOIN banking.party.party_identifier bic ON bic.party_id = p.party_id AND bic.id_scheme_code = 'BIC'
LEFT JOIN banking.party.party_relationship rel ON rel.party_id = p.party_id AND rel.relationship_type = 'UltimateParent'
LEFT JOIN banking.party.party parent ON parent.party_id = rel.related_party_id

tables.name: v_person_directory_masked
tables.description: Persons without direct personal data: last name reduced to an initial and e-mail masked. Safe for wide access.
tables.definition:
SELECT person_id, party_id, first_name, LEFT(last_name, 1) AS last_initial, job_title, is_trader, MASK(email) AS masked_email
FROM banking.party.person

tables.name: v_trade_counterparties
tables.description: The parties on each trade with their role, LEI and account.
tables.definition:
SELECT r.trade_id, pr.party_role_name AS party_role, p.party_id, p.party_name, lei.identifier_value AS lei, a.account_name
FROM banking.trade.trade_party_role r
JOIN banking.ref.party_role pr ON pr.party_role_code = r.party_role_code
JOIN banking.party.party p ON p.party_id = r.party_id
LEFT JOIN banking.party.party_identifier lei ON lei.party_id = p.party_id AND lei.id_scheme_code = 'LEI'
LEFT JOIN banking.party.account a ON a.account_id = r.account_id

tables.name: v_trade_summary
tables.description: One row per trade with status, product, asset class, book and UTI: the starting point for most trade reports.
tables.definition:
SELECT t.trade_id, t.trade_date, ts.trade_status_name AS trade_status, pt.product_type_name AS product_type, pt.asset_class_code,
       b.book_name, uti.identifier_value AS uti
FROM banking.trade.trade t
JOIN banking.ref.trade_status ts ON ts.trade_status_code = t.trade_status_code
JOIN banking.product.product p ON p.product_id = t.product_id
JOIN banking.ref.product_type pt ON pt.product_type_code = p.product_type_code
JOIN banking.party.book b ON b.book_id = t.book_id
LEFT JOIN banking.trade.trade_identifier uti ON uti.trade_id = t.trade_id AND uti.id_scheme_code = 'UTI'

metrics.name: Net MTM
